observations.claim: The second round re-evaluated two verified population seeds and generated seven new valid candidates. The seed identities were ba61c2d78b488b2b334274a7ea4266de0288b2e3c370bc9e96b17bb55fa7b897 and f279e362485eb9538c3544ee931c5a938e3eb1db1104b81e75339479487a4ebc.
The incumbent remained the baseline at mean relative gap 0.0. The second round stopped after ten evaluator attempts, bringing the two-round total to twenty; no repair was requested.

The next-round context consumed the first-round feedback basis and included its incumbent, per-instance facts, generated counts, evidence references and hashes. This run therefore demonstrates feedback consumption and multi-seed continuation.

hypotheses.claim: On this mini suite, several distinct priorities tie the saturated baseline at zero gap, so the run supports wiring and protocol claims rather than a general optimization claim.
